task: Get a reminder to call the camp director about Rafi's waitlist, and see whether the app can help you follow up with the camp.
transcript: Opened the app: a plain 'What can I help with?' screen with example requests, a text box, and a note that nothing is sent without my OK.
Typed 'Remind me to call the camp director about Rafi's waitlist spot, and help me follow up with the camp' and pressed enter.
A page titled 'Follow up on Rafi's camp waitlist spot' appeared saying 'A new helper, family-admin, is on it' with 'Change' and 'Show work' links, then 'Working on it'.

After about 50 seconds: 'Done. I'll remind you tomorrow (Fri, Nov 13) at 10:00 am to call the camp director', plus four good questions to ask on the call and the start of a follow-up email with blanks, saying it had not sent anything and did not know the camp's name or email.
Scrolled down three times to read the rest of the email; the screen did not move, so I could only see 'Subject' and 'Hi [Director's name],'.
Asked 'can you look in my email for the camp? the director's name and email should be in there'. The earlier answer's tail now showed it had said it couldn't look through my email unless I asked.
Waited about 3 minutes with 'Working on it'.

Answer: camp is Camp Kaylie, director Marcy Feld, marcy@campkaylie.test, (845) 555-0142; Oct 20 email said Rafi is #4 for Session 2 (July 6-31) with openings usually by month end; my Nov 1 check-in got no reply, so call today. Said the filled-in email is set up as a reply in the same thread.
Scrolled down again to see the email; screen still did not move.
Typed 'I can't see the email, can you show me just the email?'. A small pop-up appeared at the bottom: 'family-admin started working / Monitor family calendar for prep needs'.

About a minute later it showed just the email: To marcy@campkaylie.test, Subject 'Re: Rafi Levin - Session 2 waitlist', a short note with blanks for the waitlist number and date, signed Dana, plus a shorter 'nudge' version if I can't reach her, and asked which one I want it to get ready to send once I OK it.
Stopped there; did not send anything.
jargon_seen: Monitor family calendar for prep needs
stumbles: It did not look in my email on its own even though I said 'follow up with the camp'; I had to ask a second time, and the line saying it could look was hidden at the bottom of a long answer I could not scroll to.
Scrolling down did nothing, so long answers were cut off and I could not read the drafted email until I asked to see it alone.
The email search took about 3 minutes of 'Working on it' with no hint of progress.
A pop-up about 'family-admin' starting 'Monitor family calendar for prep needs' appeared, which I never asked for and did not understand.
The reminder was set for 10:00 the next day without asking me when; fine, but I had to trust it since I never saw it on a calendar.
verdict: I got the reminder, smart questions for the call, the director's real name, email and phone from my inbox, and a ready reply email, and nothing went out without my say. It took three messages and a few minutes of waiting where ChatGPT-style would be one, and long answers I could not scroll made me ask again just to read the email.
